It opens with a man in a suit asking another man what he thinks about "that". The second man, in a leather jacket, says “I Love it”. The video transitions to a compilation of various commentators and analysts discussing Bronny's potential and talent, accompanied by footage of him playing basketball. Some, like a man in a tan suit, express admiration for Bronny's skills, describing him as a "legitimate McDonald's All-American". Another expert describes how he has grown and has increased his explosiveness on the defensive end. There are also shots of Bronny with his family, including LeBron. However, others express skepticism, questioning whether he is worthy of being a lottery pick, with one man exclaiming, “He’s a bench guy?”  The debates around his ranking and the potential impact of his father's reputation are also highlighted. Some are quoted as saying that he will "never going to be in the same sentence as Lebron James" and some are laughing at the mention of Bronny playing. The segment ends with LeBron James' tweet claiming that Bronny is “definitely better than some of these cats I’ve been watching on league pass today.” Throughout the video, there are text overlays with comments and sound effects to emphasize different points of view. The settings vary from sports studio sets with brick or modern backdrops to home offices, with the speakers appearing to be in professional settings.
